quests.title: Etienne's Raw Meat Request

dialogue.t: Phew... My savior! You're finally here.
You've brought all the raw meat, right? Hand them over. I'll get Baguette's dish done and go to rest.
Great, thanks. This is for you, {NICKNAME}. I can finally cook something nice this time.

quests.description: Etienne needs 8 servings of Raw Meat.
